title: Record in original language; English translation
bodyText: . A record filed with a tribunal of this State under this article shall be in the original language and, if not in English, shall be accompanied by an English translation.
bodyHtml: §576B-713  Record in original language; English translation.  A record filed with a tribunal of this State under this article shall be in the original language and, if not in English, shall be accompanied by an English translation. [L 2015, c 77, pt of §1]
